header: HOW THIS TOPIC LOOKS IN THE PANEL OF THE SEARCH BAR: the provident fund page, with its tile and its page, which has two tabs (PF maturity, PF loan EMI). Its logic is in the files beside this one; what the search line needs to know is in topic.ts. I list it once only, in src/tools/registry.ui.tsx.

doc: I set THE WIDTH OF THE PF PAGE'S BOX in rem, so it follows the text size and the zoom, and it is never more than the page. This is the one number to change to make the page narrower or wider, in small steps (4 rem is about 64 px)
